title: tool.nudge payload (v1)
description: Durable record of one scheduled reminder for the next model invocation (NUDGE-DESIGN §7). Denotes scheduling inside this run, not remote receipt; the reminder text itself is rendered from the fixed template and never stored.

reason.description: Typed failure reason vocabulary of the repeated call.

repeat_count.description: Occurrence count of the canonical identical-call signature inside the 10-call window at seal time.
